run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T07:55:03Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend-proxy RequestErrorRate alert is a downstream symptom of a failed product-catalog rollout in namespace otel-demo. Deployment product-catalog (generation 4, helm revision 2) was switched to image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0; the new ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966 created pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk at 07:55:31Z, which sits Pending with container waiting reason ImagePullBackOff (401 UNAUTHORIZED resolving the manifest), while ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog) was scaled 1 to 0 at 07:55:23Z. The product-catalog Service (ClusterIP 100.69.9.250:8080) now has only a notReadyAddresses entry, product-catalog span rate fell to exactly 0 from the window ending 07:59:03Z, and frontend's gRPC client spans to oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct fail with rpc.grpc.status_code=14 'connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080'. frontend returns HTTP 500 on /api/products/{productId}, /api/recommendations and /api/checkout, and frontend-proxy records error spans (error=true, http.status_code=500) on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' - 4573.5 and 4561.3 error spans over 06:55:03-08:10:35Z, with a near-zero baseline for the preceding 25 minutes of the same series. checkout and recommendation report their own ProductCatalogService gRPC errors. Small persistent flagd EventStream errors on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation are pre-existing and unrelated. The alert's exact expression and 18.1889 value could not be reproduced from any readable metric.

claims.text: frontend-proxy recorded error spans in the query window: increase of 4573.5 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on span_name='ingress' and 4561.3 on span_name='router frontend egress' between 06:55:03Z and 08:10:35Z, alongside 19691.8 and 19704.0 STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans.

The frontend-proxy error spans carry error=true, http.status_code=500 and otel.status_code=ERROR on both 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' operations, i.e. the proxy was returning 500 responses for upstream frontend calls.

The frontend-proxy ingress error rate was zero or near zero (0.0037-0.0111 spans/s) through the 5m window ending 07:52:03Z, then rose to 0.7375 (ending 07:57:03Z), 6.3963 (ending 08:00:03Z), 7.3222 (ending 08:03:03Z) and 5.2892 (ending 08:09:03Z).

Over the 24h lookback ending 08:10:35Z, the increase of frontend-proxy 'ingress' ERROR spans is 4573.5 and of recommendation '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' ERROR spans is 4.07 - i.e. the frontend-proxy error volume is concentrated in this incident while the flagd series is tiny.

The product-catalog Deployment in namespace otel-demo is at generation 4 and runs image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 (container name product-catalog); its status has Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable ('Deployment does not have minimum availability') and unavailableReplicas=1.

product-catalog is the only workload using an unusual image: every other Deployment in otel-demo runs ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-*, valkey/valkey:8.1.3-alpine, otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.135.0 or ghcr.io/open-feature/flagd:v0.12.8 and reports readyReplicas=1, while product-catalog shows readyReplicas=<none> with 1 updated replica.

The only existing product-catalog pod is product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk: phase Pending, Ready=False (ContainersNotReady, 'containers with unready status: [product-catalog]'), created 2026-11-15T07:55:31Z, owned by ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966; its container is waiting with reason ImagePullBackOff and message 'Back-off pulling image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0": ErrImagePull: failed to pull and unpack image ... 401 UNAUTHORIZED'.

Kubernetes events show the rollout and the pull failure: ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966 SuccessfulCreate at 07:55:16Z and 07:55:31Z and SuccessfulDelete of pod ...-8rw7j at 07:55:23Z; Deployment product-catalog scaled ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0 at 07:55:23Z; pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-qz548 was 'Killing / Stopping container product-catalog' at 07:55:23Z; Warning events Failed/ErrImagePull and Failed/ImagePullBackOff on quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 repeat (ImagePullBackOff count 21 on h9xjk by 08:00:46Z).

Deployment product-catalog owns two ReplicaSets: product-catalog-56fbb5f966 (created 07:55:15Z, image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0, spec replicas 1, no ready/available replicas) and product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 07:21:42Z, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, spec replicas 0).

product-catalog stopped producing spans: its 2m span rate was 7.3-15.2/s for oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and 0.5-1.3/s for ListProducts up to the window ending 07:57:03Z, then exactly 0 at every point from the window ending 07:59:03Z through 08:07:03Z.

Service product-catalog is a ClusterIP service on 100.69.9.250:8080 (port name tcp-service) and its Endpoints contain no ready addresses - only notReadyAddresses 100.96.4.116 pointing at pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk on node i-0c040f223cc7e47d7.

frontend's gRPC client spans to oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct fail with rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080 - Local (0.0.0.0:0)' - that address and port being the product-catalog Service ClusterIP and port.

frontend has its own error spans in the window: grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 3472.8, 'executing api route (pages) /api/products/[productId]' 3463.2, 'GET /api/products/{productId}' 3454.5, client 'GET' 4125.5, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 659.7, 'executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations' 657.9, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 411.9, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 411.75, 'POST /api/checkout' 411.5 and tcp.connect 21.3; in the same window its error spans for grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, 'GET /api/cart' and 'GET /api/data' were 0.

recommendation has its own error spans in the window: client span '/oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts' 663.9 and internal span 'get_product_list' 663.9, plus a small flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 4.07.

checkout has its own error spans in the window: client span oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 414 and server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 414, while its HTTP POST, orders publish, CartService/GetCart, CartService/EmptyCart, CurrencyService/Convert and PaymentService/Charge spans are STATUS_CODE_UNSET only.

product-catalog's own server spans never carry an error status: in the window it recorded only STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 15211.8, ListProducts 1254.3) and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, so its failure is visible in pod/endpoint state rather than in its span status.

The error spans reported for ad (2.04) and fraud-detection (3.06) over the 24h lookback are exclusively flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (plus ResolveBoolean/ResolveInt series at 0), i.e. a persistent small flagd pattern rather than product-catalog-related failures.

Pod inventory at query time: 20 of 21 pods in otel-demo are Running with ready=true and restartCount 0 (including frontend-675fd7b5c5-gx54w, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-zj87n, checkout-5dccddf8bb-z84lb, recommendation-5f45f75855-92wk6); the single exception is product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk, which is Pending with ready=false.

Primary cause: the product-catalog Deployment rollout to the unpullable image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 (new ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966) replaced the working pod of ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc at 07:55:23Z, leaving the product-catalog Service with no ready endpoints; callers' gRPC calls to 100.69.9.250:8080 then fail with status 14 UNAVAILABLE, frontend turns those into HTTP 500 on /api/products/{productId}, /api/recommendations and /api/checkout, and frontend-proxy's 'ingress' / 'router frontend egress' spans record 500 - which is what the RequestErrorRate alert on frontend-proxy is measuring.

Open question inside the cause: the pull error is '401 UNAUTHORIZED' while resolving the manifest of quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0, which is consistent either with a nonexistent/typo'd repository path or with missing registry credentials for a private repository; the evidence does not distinguish which applies.

Rejected: flagd EventStream errors explain the frontend-proxy alert. ad (2.04) and fraud-detection (3.06) 24h error increases consist only of flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream, and recommendation's flagd EventStream is only 4.07 over 24h - tiny, continuously present, and unrelated to the 4561-4573 product-catalog-driven 500s at frontend-proxy.

Rejected: frontend-proxy itself is the origin of the failures. Its error spans are 500 responses whose traces show frontend failing with exception '14 UNAVAILABLE' against the product-catalog ClusterIP, while frontend-proxy's non-error spans continue (19691.8 STATUS_CODE_UNSET on ingress), so the proxy relays frontend's failing requests rather than failing on its own upstream path.

The trace-derived frontend-proxy error ratio does not reproduce the alert's stated value: at 08:10:00Z the 5m ratio of STATUS_CODE_ERROR to all frontend-proxy spans was 55.6%, and the whole-window ratio is about 18.8%, but the alert's own expression could not be read, so the metric definition behind the annotation's 18.18888888888889 remains unverified even though the underlying error spans are confirmed.

Revert Deployment product-catalog in namespace otel-demo to the previously running image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog (the image of ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc), or point it at a valid, pullable image with the needed registry credentials, then confirm a product-catalog pod reaches Ready and the Service endpoints gain a ready address.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not readable: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned status no_data, so the alert expression, its threshold and its 18.18888888888889 current value could not be verified against a metric; the alert metric definition remains unknown rather than zero.

kube-state-metrics series are absent for this window: the kube_deployment_status_replicas_* range query returned no_data, get_metric_names for {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned no_data, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available instant query returned no_data; deployment availability therefore came from the Kubernetes API's current state, which cannot prove what the objects looked like earlier in the incident.

Kubernetes objects were read after the incident window; pod/ReplicaSet/Deployment state is 'now', so the pre-07:55 shape of product-catalog (a ready pod on ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc) is inferred from ReplicaSet replicas, images and events rather than observed directly.

Application logs could not be read: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-gx54w returned status no_data with zero lines for 07:54-08:10Z and for the error-filtered 07:50-08:10Z attempt, and the previous container instance was unavailable; logs of the deleted product-catalog pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-qz548 are gone and the pending replacement never started, so no container log text is available.

The change_history integration is not integrated in this Run, so who or what changed the product-catalog Deployment image (Helm release otel-demo revision 2, manual edit, or automation) cannot be determined.

The two trace-based views 8eb3b148-2774-4875-972a-819e16f0df7e-t2:867626ea-e886-4e1d-a523-30600b7fee4f and 1891eeda-6221-4a03-8f37-053530aaa681-t1:5df894b1-0a58-4558-a5b2-fa397517b397 are marked incomplete ('backend returned as many traces as requested; more may exist'), so the trace-level findings are a sampled view and do not establish the number of affected requests or a complete call chain; spans whose parents were not visible remain unknown.

No http_server_request_duration_seconds_count series, no rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count series and no NetworkPolicy objects were found for the targets queried (all returned no_data), so request-level error percentages, per-gRPC-method status codes and any policy-level explanation could not be verified.

Span counts in traces_span_metrics_calls_total cover every operation of a service (internal, client and server spans) and are not unique request counts; services whose error series were not returned (cart, currency, shipping, email) have unknown health in this window, and only frontend's client spans to CartService and AdService showed 0 error counts.
next_steps: Restore product-catalog by setting the Deployment image back to ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog and confirm the new pod becomes Ready and the product-catalog Endpoints gain a ready address.

Validate the intended image reference and registry credentials for quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 before any further rollout, and add a pre-rollout image-existence/pullability check or a maxUnavailable gate so an unpullable image cannot take the last replica down.
Read the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule files (outside this Run's available sources) to confirm which metric and window produced 18.18888888888889.
Inspect the otel-demo change pipeline (Helm release otel-demo, revision 2) to identify who or what applied the invalid image at about 07:55Z once change history is available.
